faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology (GBPUAT) for research positions based in Pantnagar, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by GBPUAT?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Senior Research Fellow (SRF) under the Department of Entomology with a total of 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving the completed offline application form at the university is 15-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary or stipend offered for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position will receive a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential educational qualifications required for this SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's degree in Agriculture Entomology with a 4-year Bachelor's degree or a 3-year Bachelor's degree along with NET qualification and 1-year experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any prior experience required to apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants are required to have at least 01 year of experience in conducting bio-efficacy field trials in the specialized area of Entomology.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for GBPUAT Senior Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates need to send their filled application form along with attested copies of certificates by post.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview scheduled for the shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates who apply for the Senior Research Fellow post is scheduled to be held on 16-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form should be sent directly to the Principal Investigator on his or her respective departmental address at GBPUAT Pantnagar.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application details?
faq.answer: You can check the official notification PDF and details through the important links section provided in this recruitment article.
